entries.name: el-kpi-aov
entries.sql:
select sum(Q1."AMOUNT_USD") / nullif(count(distinct Q1."ORDER_ID"), 0) "AOV"
from ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.FCT_ORDERS Q1

entries.name: el-rev-month
entries.sql:
with Q1 as (
  select date_trunc('month', "CREATED_AT") "Month of Created At", "REGION" "Region", "AMOUNT_USD"
  from ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.FCT_ORDERS
  where "CREATED_AT" >= '2025-10-01'
)
select Q1."Month of Created At", Q1."Region", sum(Q1."AMOUNT_USD") "Revenue"
from Q1
group by 1, 2
order by 1 asc
limit 25000

entries.name: el-rev-region
entries.sql:
with Q1 as (
  select * from analytics.public.fct_orders
)
select Q1."REGION" "Region", sum(Q1."AMOUNT_USD") "Revenue (USD)"
from Q1
where Q1."REGION" in ('EMEA')
group by 1
order by 2 desc
limit 25000

entries.name: el-status-donut
entries.sql:
select Q1."STATUS" "Status", sum(Q1."AMOUNT_USD") "Revenue"
from ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.FCT_ORDERS Q1
group by 1
limit 25000

entries.name: el-orders-table
entries.sql:
select Q1."ORDER_ID" "Order Id", Q1."CREATED_AT" "Created At", Q1."AMOUNT_USD" "Amount", Q1."STATUS" "Status"
from ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.FCT_ORDERS Q1
order by 2 desc
limit 25000

entries.name: el-rolling
entries.sql:
with Q1 as (
  select date_trunc('day', "CREATED_AT") "Day of Created At", sum("AMOUNT_USD") "S"
  from ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.FCT_ORDERS
  group by 1
)
select "Day of Created At",
  avg("S") over (order by "Day of Created At" rows between 6 preceding and current row) "Moving Revenue"
from Q1
order by 1

entries.name: el-orders-src
entries.sql:
select * from (select * from analytics.public.fct_orders) Q1
limit 25000
